name: B Accordion – Flexible Accordion Layouts for Content Display
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Easily create stylish and fully customizable accordion for your WordPress sites. Perfect for FAQs, toggle sections, or content organization. Supports responsive design, smoothly, and dynamic content or images as your needed. No coding required—just add, and customization!

👉Demos

Features

  • Fully Customizable Accordion: Adjust colors, variants fonts, spacing, and other design elements to match your theme.
  • Dynamic Content Support: Insert text, images, links, or even shortcodes inside accordion items.
  • Responsive: Works seamlessly on all devices, including desktops, tablets, and smartphones.
  • Multiple Accordion Blocks: Add multiple accordion blocks to a single page or post without conflicts.
  • Expandable and Collapsible Items: Accordion items expand and collapse smoothly with user interactions.
  • Default Open/Closed State: Set each accordion item to start in an open or closed state based on your preference.
  • Icon Support for Toggles: Choose from various toggle icons or upload custom icons for expand and collapse actions.
  • Customizable Header Styles: Easily style the accordion headers, including fonts, colors, and hover effects.
  • Shortcode Support: Use shortcode to insert the accordion in classic editors or widget areas.
  • No Coding Required: User-friendly interface makes it easy to build and style accordions without technical skills.
  • Multiple Style Variation: Includes pre-designed accordion styles to get started quickly.

How to use

  • First, install the B Accordion plugin
  • Add the Accordion block from the block category called “Widgets” in the Gutenberg editor.
  • You can change block settings from the right-side settings sidebar.

  • Enjoy!

  • For installation help click on Installation Tab.

sections.installation:
From Gutenberg Editor:

  1. Go to the WordPress Block/Gutenberg Editor
  2. Search For B Accordion
  3. Click on the Accordion to add the block

Download & Upload:

  1. Download the B Accordion plugin (.zip file)
  2. In your admin area, go to the Plugins menu and click on Add New
  3. Click on Upload Plugin and choose the b-accordion.zip file and click on Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin and Enjoy!

Manually:

  1. Download and upload the B Accordion plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Is B Accordion Block free?

Yes, B Accordion Block is a free Gutenberg block plugin.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it will work with any standard WordPress theme.

Can I change block settings?

Yes, you can change block settings from the Gutenberg block editor’s right sidebar.

How many times can I reuse a block?

You can use unlimited times as you want.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here
